description: Core concepts in computer science including algorithms, data structures, and systems

algorithms.definition: Step-by-step procedure for solving a problem or accomplishing a task

complexity.time_complexity: How runtime grows with input size
complexity.space_complexity: How memory usage grows with input size

sorting_algorithms.bubble_sort: Repeatedly swap adjacent out-of-order elements; O(n²)
sorting_algorithms.selection_sort: Find minimum, place at front; O(n²)
sorting_algorithms.insertion_sort: Build sorted portion one element at a time; O(n²) worst, O(n) best
sorting_algorithms.merge_sort: Divide and conquer; stable; O(n log n)
sorting_algorithms.quick_sort: Partition around pivot; average O(n log n), worst O(n²)

data_structures.array: Fixed-size sequential collection; O(1) access, O(n) insert/delete
data_structures.linked_list: Nodes with value and pointer to next; O(1) insert/delete at head, O(n) search
data_structures.stack: LIFO (Last In First Out); push/pop operations
data_structures.queue: FIFO (First In First Out); enqueue/dequeue operations
data_structures.hash_table: Key-value pairs with O(1) average lookup; uses hash function
data_structures.binary_tree: Each node has at most two children
data_structures.binary_search_tree: Left child < parent < right child; O(log n) search
data_structures.heap: Complete binary tree; max-heap or min-heap property
data_structures.graph: Nodes and edges; can be directed or undirected, weighted or unweighted
data_structures.trie: Tree-like structure for string prefix operations

programming_paradigms.imperative: Specify how to do something step by step
programming_paradigms.object_oriented: Organize code into objects with data and methods
programming_paradigms.functional: Functions as first-class citizens; avoid side effects

oop_principles.encapsulation: Bundle data and methods; hide internal state
oop_principles.inheritance: Classes inherit properties and methods from parent classes
oop_principles.polymorphism: Objects of different types accessed through same interface
oop_principles.abstraction: Hide complex implementation details; expose simple interface

computer_architecture.cpu: Central Processing Unit; executes instructions (ALU, control unit, registers)
computer_architecture.von_neumann_architecture: Single shared memory for instructions and data
computer_architecture.binary: Base-2 number system (0s and 1s); foundation of digital computing
computer_architecture.bits_and_bytes: 1 bit = 0 or 1; 1 byte = 8 bits; 1 KB = 1024 bytes

operating_systems.function: Manages hardware resources and provides services to applications
operating_systems.process_vs_thread: Process: independent program with own memory; Thread: lighter unit sharing process memory

protocols.dns: Resolves domain names to IP addresses
